address: 66 Knightsbridge, Knightsbridge, London, SW1X 7LA, United Kingdom
bio: The menu may take inspiration from one of England's oldest recipe books, The Forme of Cury, but there is still something decidedly 'Heston' about the modern and creative dishes on show at this restaurant housed inside The Mandarin Oriental Hotel. You need only take one look at dishes like the signature illusory 'Meat Fruit' to see the eponymous chef's playful influence. Crucially, the flavours of the creations are sublime too, with the aforementioned dish providing a smooth, utterly delicious chicken liver parfait, regardless of its fun, fruity form....
